snippet.title: SOL PROTOCOL - RELEASE WINDOW - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description: Sol Protocol is a  VR co-op roguelike where you team up and physically pilot a spaceship through dangerous, procedurally generated stellar systems. Manage your spaceship inside and out, man the turrets, explore abandoned stations or bases on foot, and make strategic decisions together as you push deeper into the unknown deep space. Communication, trust and improvisation are the keys for survival. Early Access release on Meta Store September 2026.
